title: Comment
description: A public comment submitted on a federal regulatory document via the Regulations.gov API.

id.description: The JSON:API resource ID (documentId of the comment)

agencyId.description: The acronym used to abbreviate the name of the agency associated with the document.

highlightedContent.description: Content highlighted by search engine for the searchTerm.

lastModifiedDate.description: The date comment was last modified in the system.

objectId.description: The internal ID of the comment in our system.

postedDate.description: The date that the comment was posted by the agency to the system.

title.description: The formal title of the document.

withdrawn.description: Conveys if the comment is withdrawn.

comment.description: The comment text associated with the comment submission.

docketId.description: The ID of the docket to which the document corresponds.

organization.description: The organization that the submitter represents.

postedDate.description: The date that the comment was posted.

receiveDate.description: The date that the comment was received by the agency.
